text_block_list.text: Heeeey, Trainer! Listen to this!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm making my rounds
throughout the academy, I spot
Smart
Falcon running my way with a huge grin on
her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be cheerleading at the next
Tracen Meet! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Held twice a year at Академия Тайсен, the
Tracen Meet is a race that
never fails to
attract a crowd. It's one of the institution's
largest
events.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yep! The one and only! There's gonna be
sooo many people coming
to watch!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can make all those people my
fans if I dance for them!
Ehehe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Later that evening, I run into her a second
time, but her energy is
drastically
different.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Go, go. You can do it.
Let's go. Do it, do
it...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm about to call out to her when I notice
her talk to another
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really wanted to dance, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Why'd they put us on flag duty
anyway?
text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
"You should do dirt racing!" this. "You're
really good at twirling a
flag!" that. It's like
we never get a say in what we do.
Nobody's ever
gonna notice us at this
rate...
text_block_list.name: Dirt-Racing Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
It appears the two have been assigned to
flag duty instead of the
main cheerleading
roles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As I try to come up with something
positive to say...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, it is what it is, so we might as well
make the most of it and do
our best!
C'mon, let's get back to practice!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So we hold it like this... and spin it like
that! Then we do this, and...
voila! Easy as
pie!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Their flags flutter in the evening sky. As I
watch the two flag-bearers
handle the
heavy poles with ease, I begin to
understand why they
were assigned that
role.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With their practice now complete, Smart
Falcon's partner takes her
leave, leaving
me free to approach the now-alone
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... That took way more energy than I thought it would... I'm totally exhausted!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: You twirled that flag like a champ.

text_block_list.text: Whoa, Trainer! When did you get here?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really did want to show off my cute dance moves instead of... this.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I guess that's true... Maybe I'll still be able
to wow people like this.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон remains a bit doubtful, but
the day of the Tracen Meet
arrives
regardless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Go! Go! You can do it!
Let's go! Do it! Do
it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон twirls her flag next to the
breathtaking dancers, waiting
for her time
in the spotlight. When it's finally her turn,
she moves to
the center and seizes the
opportunity.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Go! Go! YOU CAN DO IT!
Let's go! Do it!
DO IT!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at her with the flag! She's
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The way she handles that thing...
I've never seen someone so in
sync with
their flag!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Man, these cheerleaders are crazy good!
Are you seeing this?! Tell me
who else
could pull off a pyramid like that!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're right! And look at their
beautiful smiles! They're so cool
and cute
that I can't take my eyes off them! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Sigh... "The flag-bearers were great, but the cheerleaders were the stars of the show!" is all I keep hearing...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I knew I couldn't compete with them...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: You did your best, and that's what matters!

text_block_list.text:
But they probably won't remember who I
am! Maybe they'll be able to
recall the
flag's pattern, but not who waved it...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Some results take time and effort to
attain, and becoming a top
Umadol might
be one of them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
